source: Third-party coverage of the 11th edition core rules (Wargamer). Partial: only the stratagems explicitly described as 11th edition are listed. Wording is paraphrased.

items.w: Your Charge phase, after a MONSTER or VEHICLE of yours completes a charge move.
items.t: Replaces Tank Shock. Roll a number of D6 equal to the charging unit's Toughness; each 5+ is a mortal wound on an engaged enemy unit (up to six), and each 1 is a mortal wound on your own unit.

items.w: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
items.t: One of your units within 24" of an enemy unit that it can shoot fires at it using Snap Shooting: hits only on unmodified 6s, no re-rolls.

items.w: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
items.t: One of your unengaged units within 12" of an enemy unit makes a charge move. By default it can only target enemy units that made a charge move this turn (Leap to Defend); for +1 CP it can target any enemy unit within 6" with the charge roll capped at 6 (Into the Fray).
